name: 2012 livery (black fern)
description: White forward fuselage with 'AIR NEW ZEALAND' in dark serif italic capitals over the forward windows; from mid-cabin a black sweep curves up from the belly to take the rear fuselage and fin, carrying a big white silver-fern frond that rises into the fin; the white koru on the black fin; black winglets with the koru.

sources.title: ZK-OXL @ ZQN, 2018-10-06 (CC BY 2.0, Ev Brown)
sources.note: A320, left side level: positions of the black sweep, fern, koru, titles, sharklets.

sources.title: ZK-NZQ at PVG Airport (CC BY-SA 4.0, TNLHK)
sources.note: 787-9, left side, 202x: same scheme on the widebody; the black starts relatively further aft.

sources.title: Air New Zealand (Wikipedia)
sources.note: Black and white livery with the fern introduced 2012.

logos.description: The Air New Zealand koru: a white Maori spiral curl above a horizontal bar, with a smaller curl below, standing upright in the lower-middle of the black fin.

A large white silver-fern frond on the black rear fuselage: its stem curves from low on the side, about level with the wing's trailing edge, up and aft to the fin's root, the leaflets fanning upward; the tip runs into the fin below the koru.
The koru in white on each black winglet's outer face.
The small Star Alliance star with 'A STAR ALLIANCE MEMBER' below, behind the cockpit windows.

titles.style: Dark serif capitals with a slight slant and flared, calligraphic thick-thin strokes, over the forward windows from just aft of the first door.

notes: Same scheme on the A320/A321neo, 787-9 and 777. On the 787 the black sweep starts a little further aft (about x 0.6 at the windows, 0.69 at the crown) than on the A320 drawn here. Some aircraft are all-black (see all-black.json). Belly not seen in a photo: the black sweep is drawn wrapping under it. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on ZK-OXL, placed by its forward door and overwing exits (which agree with the measured A320 to 0.005): the title runs 0.168 to 0.404 with its cap height about a fifth of the radius, and the black sweep's forward edge is a curve about 1.5 m further aft than drawn (0.51 low on the side, 0.57 at the windows, 0.69 at the crown); under the wing it is extrapolated to the belly.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximation. Introduced in 2012, replacing the teal-and-blue 'Pacific Wave' scheme (1996), long since gone.
